MurkyFishEye.name: Fish Eye
MurkyFishEye.description: Egg's Health is increased by 100%, its sight radius is increased by 300% and it can see Stealthed enemies. Passive: Spawning from his Egg increases Murky's mount speed to 45% for 5 seconds.

MurkyEggHunt.name: Egg Hunt
MurkyEggHunt.description: Activate to place a fake Egg. If the fake Egg dies, it casts an untalented Slime. Maximum 3 fake Eggs. Passive: Spawning from his Egg grants Murky Stealth for 5 seconds.

MurkyAFishyDeal.name: A Fishy Deal
MurkyAFishyDeal.description: Killing a Minion with Pufferfish grants a stack of Bribe. Use 8 stacks to bribe a Mercenary, instantly defeating them. Does not work on Elite Mercenaries. Maximum of 32 stacks of Bribe.

MurkySlimeTime.name: Slime Time
MurkySlimeTime.description: Quest: Slime enemy Heroes that are already Slimed. Reward: After Sliming 10 Heroes, increase Slime's bonus damage by 125. Reward: After Sliming 20 Heroes, increase Slime's slow amount to 30%.

MurkyMasteryTufferfish.name: Tufferfish
MurkyMasteryTufferfish.description: Pufferfish gains 50 Spell Armor and deals 50% more damage to Slimed targets.

MurkyLivingtheDream.name: Living the Dream
MurkyLivingtheDream.description: Quest: Every 15 seconds Murky is alive, he gains 5% Spell Power, up to 25%. This bonus is reset upon his death.

MurkySlipperyWhenWet.name: Slippery When Wet
MurkySlipperyWhenWet.description: Gain 50% Movement Speed and move through units while in Safety Bubble. Additionally, Safety Bubble's cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

MurkyTimetoKrill.name: Time to Krill
MurkyTimetoKrill.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes deal an additional 7 (+4% per level) damage a second and slow the target by 7% for 4 seconds. This effect can stack up to 5 times.

MurkyHeroicAbilityMarchoftheMurlocs.name: March of the Murlocs
MurkyHeroicAbilityMarchoftheMurlocs.description: After 0.75 seconds, Murky commands a legion of Murlocs to march in a target direction, each one leaping onto the first enemy Hero or Structure they find. Each Murloc deals 125 (+4% per level) damage and slows its target by 15% for 5 seconds. Murlocs deal 50% damage to Structures.

MurkyHeroicAbilityOctoGrab.name: Octo-Grab
MurkyHeroicAbilityOctoGrab.description: Murky becomes Unstoppable and Stuns target enemy Hero for 3 seconds while he hits them for 1 damage a second.

MurkyMasteryRejuvenatingBubble.name: Rejuvenating Bubble
MurkyMasteryRejuvenatingBubble.description: Safety Bubble restores 40% of Murky's maximum Health.

MurkyEggShell.name: Egg Shell
MurkyEggShell.description: Spawning from his Egg grants Murky a Shield equal to 100% of his maximum Health. The shield lasts indefinitely.

MurkyFishTank.name: Fish Tank
MurkyFishTank.description: Murky is healed for 25% of the damage he deals with Basic Attacks and Basic Abilities.

MurkyToxicBuildup.name: Toxic Buildup
MurkyToxicBuildup.description: Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack against an enemy Hero causes a free Slime to be cast upon them.

MurkyFishOil.name: Fish Oil
MurkyFishOil.description: The Pufferfish casts Slime at its location upon landing.

MurkyMasteryWrathOfCod.name: Wrath of Cod
MurkyMasteryWrathOfCod.description: Heroes hit by Pufferfish take additional damage equal to 15% of their maximum Health over 5 seconds.

MurkyMasteryNeverEndingMurlocs.name: Never-Ending Murlocs
MurkyMasteryNeverEndingMurlocs.description: March of the Murlocs can be channeled, sending little Murlocs indefinitely.

MurkyMasteryAndASharkToo.name: ... And a Shark Too!
MurkyMasteryAndASharkToo.description: Increase the damage of Octo-Grab by 13700% (+4% per level).

MurkyBigTunaKahuna.name: Big Tuna Kahuna
MurkyBigTunaKahuna.description: Murky's maximum Health and Egg respawn time are doubled.

MurkyMakingInky.name: Making Inky
MurkyMakingInky.description: Reduces the cooldown of Slime from 4 seconds to 2 seconds.
